title.en: Sony fits digital vision into a 1mm square—but the medical outcome is still ahead
title.zh: Sony把数字视力装进一毫米方块，医疗成效仍待验证

summary.en: Sony announces a tiny sensor and long-cable digital transmission; planned samples and manufacturer tests are distinct from approved devices or patient outcomes.
summary.zh: Sony公布微型传感器及长线数字传输；计划样品、厂商测试，不等于获批医疗器械或患者成效。

title.en: Tencent pitches 100-plus AI specialists—and leaves the final review to you
title.zh: 腾讯推出逾百种AI专家角色，最后一关仍由你来审

summary.en: Tencent describes coordinated specialist personas producing one draft; expert labels and shared work are not independent validation or measured productivity.
summary.zh: 腾讯介绍专家角色协作生成统一草稿；专家标签、共享信息，不等于独立验证或实测生产率。
